materiality.rationale: Frontier model as engineering/science instrument: global GA with aggressive intro pricing, plus unusually concrete deployment anecdotes (Chrome refactor, ADK, xTB, Gamow) and a robotics thread (ERQA, cornhole). Reader learns breadth of claimed impact and must discount for vendor sourcing; Minecraft paper (traced) shows long-horizon coding evidence with stated limits. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]
